item.title: Wilmington man faces more than 11 years in prison following Retail Store Crime Spree
item.description: Leon Ross Jr., a 60-year-old man from Wilmington, pled guilty last week to sixteen counts of Habitual Larceny arising from thefts in Wilmington retail stores beginning in November of 2024.

item.title: 39th Annual Plant Sale hosted at the New Hanover County Arboretum is coming up
item.description: The Extension Master Gardner Volunteer Association is thrilled to announce the return of their annual plant sale. The event is scheduled to take place throughout April 16-19.

item.title: Town of Carolina Beach schedules Sanitary Sewer Smoke Testing for next week
item.description: The Town of Carolina Beach will conduct smoke testing of the sanitary sewer system next week, February 24-26.

item.title: New Hanover County Schools financial officer receives state-wide award
item.description: The North Carolina Association of School Business Officials named Ashley Sutton as the 2026 recipient of the Lou Thompson Distinguished Service Award.

item.title: Seahawks sale process begins less than 2 weeks after winning Super Bowl, Paul Allen’s estate says
item.description: The Seattle Seahawks are going up for sale in accordance with the wishes of late team owner Paul Allen.

item.title: Nvidia leads the US stock market higher
item.description: The U.S. stock market ticked higher on Wednesday, led by its most influential stock, Nvidia. The S&P 500 rose 0.6% and pulled a bit closer to its all-time high set late last month. The Dow Jones Industrial Average added 129 points, or 0.3%, and the Nasdaq composite gained 0.8%.

item.title: Braves will begin season without starters Schwellenbach and Waldrep
item.description: Atlanta Braves right-handed starter Spencer Schwellenbach had surgery Wednesday to clean up “loose bodies” in his elbow, and rotation candidate Hurston Waldrep is scheduled to undergo a similar procedure next week.

item.title: Why Trump’s comment on discussing Taiwan arms sales with China has raised concerns
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump’s comment that he is discussing potential arms sales to Taiwan with Chinese President Xi Jinping is raising concerns in Taipei as the island democracy relies on U.S. backing in the face of China ’s territorial claims.

item.title: Pender County Commissioners hear update on EMS merger, changes to retirement system
item.description: Gregory Grayson, a representative with North Carolina Fire Chiefs Consulting, presented an update to county commissioners on Tuesday night.

item.title: City of Wilmington protecting systems following two cyberattacks in Cape Fear region
item.description: On Wednesday, the city's media mailbox system, which allows external viewing of emails, was taken offline.
